<h2>Convert a v1 cross validation shared design Artifact</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies the frozen v1 fixture contract and upgrades an assembled payload to
the canonical 'cross_validation_shared_design' v2 envelope.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>convert_v1_cross_validation_shared_design_artifact(
  payload = NULL,
  pipeline_id = NULL,
  configuration_profile = NULL,
  created_at = base::Sys.time(),
  v1_schema_hash = "2d727fd54623501e0ac384e0674c17f3"
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="payload">payload</code></td>
<td>
<p>Exact named v2 payload assembled from frozen v1 targets.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="pipeline_id">pipeline_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Source pipeline identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="configuration_profile">configuration_profile</code></td>
<td>
<p>Source configuration profile.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="created_at">created_at</code></td>
<td>
<p>Conversion time.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="v1_schema_hash">v1_schema_hash</code></td>
<td>
<p>Frozen v1 schema-fixture hash.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Validated migrated v2 artifact envelope.
</p>

</main>
